newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Shing hits high after COSCO deal.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing hits high after COSCO deal.

text.p: Shares of construction and property firm Shun Shing Holdings Ltd surged to hit its year high on Tuesday after China-backed COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd agreed to take a 30 percent stake in the company.
Brokers said expectation of future asset injections and the counter becoming a China-concept stock following COSCO's investment boosted demand for Shun Shing.
Shun Shing shares rose HK$0.235 or 74.6 percent to HK$0.55 per share in mid-morning on Tuesday. Volume was 234.77 million shares worth HK$80.23 million.
"Expectation of future asset injections into the company and recent strong demand for China-concept stocks aided buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.

A COSCO (Hong Kong) wholly-owned unit on Monday agreed to buy 201.6 million shares or 30 percent of Shun Shing at HK$0.315 per share. COSCO said it would hold the shares as a long term investment and had no present intention to increase its shareholding or inject assets into the company.
COSCO (Hong Kong) is the holding company of COSCO Pacific Ltd.
